  (base : CC.Integers.Ptrofs) (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State)

  (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice) (left right nextPc : BitVec 64) (aux : BitVec 32)
  (ordinaryDst : dst.reg ≠ 4) (ordinarySrc : src.reg ≠ 4)
  (dstLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w8))
  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w8))
  (leftRead :

      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))

      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))

    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))

  have value :=
    X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.b (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)) ^^^
      X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.b (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16));

        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)

        {

          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr caller cellsBlock (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr caller cellsBlock (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned caller cellsBlock
        (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst) + 8).unsigned =
      some (X86Width.argument 0#8))
  (rightTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned caller cellsBlock
        (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src) + 8).unsigned =
      some (X86Width.argument 0#8))
  (valueLayout :
    CC.PTree.get X86_program_profile_bpf._x86_sim_inline_value ge.genv_cenv = some X86ShiftLeftCarry.valueRecord)
  (applyBlock bitsBlock : CC.Block)
  (applyBinding :
    ge.genv_genv.findSymbol X86_program_profile_bpf._x86_apply_width = some applyBlock ∧
      ge.genv_genv.findFunctPtr applyBlock = some (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_apply_width))
  (bitsBinding :
    ge.genv_genv.findSymbol X86_program_profile_bpf._x86_width_bits = some bitsBlock ∧
      ge.genv_genv.findFunctPtr bitsBlock = some (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_width_bits))
  (places : X86LogicFlagOrder.Locations) (headers : X86LogicFlagOrder.HeaderLoads caller bindingBlock places)
  (differentFlags : X86LogicFlagMemory.Distinct places)
  (oldFlags :
    CC.Positive.toNat places.cf.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock ∧
      CC.Positive.toNat places.zf.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock ∧
        CC.Positive.toNat places.sf.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock ∧
          CC.Positive.toNat places.overflow.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock ∧
            CC.Positive.toNat places.pf.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock)
  (separate :
    places.cf.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧
      places.zf.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧
        places.sf.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧ places.overflow.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧ places.pf.fst ≠ bindingBlock)
  (outside :
    places.cf.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧
      places.zf.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧
        places.sf.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧ places.overflow.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧ places.pf.fst ≠ cellsBlock)
  (bindingSeparate : bindingBlock ≠ cellsBlock) (permissions : X86LogicFlagWritable.Writable caller places)
  (oldCf : BitVec 8)
  (oldByte :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned caller places.cf.fst places.cf.snd.unsigned =

        CC.Permission.Writable =
      true)

    caller.validAccess CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned cellsBlock
        (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst) + 8).unsigned CC.Permission.Writable =

  (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins) (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (cpu : X86.Cpu)
  (af : Bool) (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins caller cellsBlock cellsOffset cpu)
  (boundary : CC.isCallCont k = true) :
  have value :=
    X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.d (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)) ^^^
      X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.d (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16));

          [CC.Val.Vptr bindingBlock 0, op, X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte dst),
            X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte src), X86Width.argument flags, CC.Val.Vint aux, imm,
            X86Width.argument width]
          k caller)
        (CC.State.Returnstate CC.Val.Vundef k final) ∧
      X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins final cellsBlock cellsOffset
          (have __src := cpu.setReg X86.Size.d (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) value;

            flags := X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.d (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.d value) af cpu.flags, mem := __src.mem,
            fsBase := __src.fsBase, gsBase := __src.gsBase, xmm := __src.xmm, mxcsr := __src.mxcsr,
            oracle := __src.oracle, ms := __src.ms }) ∧
        X86LogicFlagMemory.FlagsRepresent final places
            (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.d (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.d value) af cpu.flags) ∧
          final.nextblock = (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).snd.nextblock ∧

                    row.snd.fst ≤ offset →
                      offset < row.snd.snd →
                        ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                          final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicRegisterReference.native_step (size : X86.Size)
  (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State) (dst src : Fin 16) (highDst highSrc : Bool) (kind : X86.BinKind)
  (value nextPc : BitVec 64) (running : state.modelError = none)
  (selected :
    kind = X86.BinKind.xor ∧
        value =
          (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) highDst ^^^
            (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex src) highSrc ∨
      kind = X86.BinKind.or ∧
          value =
            (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) highDst |||
              (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex src) highSrc ∨
        kind = X86.BinKind.and ∧
          value =
            (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) highDst &&&
              (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex src) highSrc) :
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.nativeStep
      (X86.Op.bin kind size (X86.Operand.reg (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) highDst)
        (X86.Operand.reg (X86.GPR.ofIndex src) highSrc))
      nextPc state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg size (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) (X86.Value.trunc size value)
                    highDst).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic size (X86.Value.trunc size value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicRegisterReference.step (width : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth)
  (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State) (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice)
  (kind : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind) (value nextPc : BitVec 64) (running : state.modelError = none)
  (selected :
    kind = KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind.xor ∧
        value =
          (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
              (dst.shift width == 8) ^^^
            (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex src.reg)
              (src.shift width == 8) ∨
      kind = KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind.or ∧
          value =
            (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                (dst.shift width == 8) |||
              (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex src.reg)
                (src.shift width == 8) ∨
        kind = KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind.and ∧
          value =
            (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                (dst.shift width == 8) &&&
              (X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex src.reg)
                (src.shift width == 8)) :
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic width kind (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register dst)
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                    (X86.Value.trunc (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) value) (dst.shift width == 8)).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width)
                (X86.Value.trunc (X86LogicRegisterReference.size width) value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicQwordOperands.xor_step (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins)
  (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (memory : CC.Mem) (block : CC.Block)
  (base : CC.Integers.Ptrofs) (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State)
  (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins memory block base (X86LogicReference.input state))
  (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice) (left right nextPc : BitVec 64) (aux : BitVec 32)
  (ordinaryDst : dst.reg ≠ 4) (ordinarySrc : src.reg ≠ 4)
  (dstLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64))
  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64))
  (leftRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (rightTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (running : state.modelError = none) :
  have value :=
    X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.q (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)) ^^^
      X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.q (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16));
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64
        KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind.xor (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register dst)
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg X86.Size.q (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                    (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.q value)
                    (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64 == 8)).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.q (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.q value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

  (af : Bool) (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins caller cellsBlock cellsOffset cpu)
  (boundary : CC.isCallCont k = true) :

            oracle := __src.oracle, ms := __src.ms }) ∧
        X86LogicFlagMemory.FlagsRepresent final places
            (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.q (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.q value) af cpu.flags) ∧
          final.nextblock = (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).snd.nextblock ∧

                row ∈ CC.blocksOfEnv ge.genv_cenv (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).fst →
                  ∀ (offset : CC.Z),
                    row.snd.fst ≤ offset →
                      offset < row.snd.snd →
                        ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                          final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧

                        block ≠ places.zf.fst ∧
                          block ≠ places.sf.fst ∧ block ≠ places.overflow.fst ∧ block ≠ places.pf.fst →

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicWordOperands.xor_step (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins)
  (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (memory : CC.Mem) (block : CC.Block)
  (base : CC.Integers.Ptrofs) (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State)
  (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins memory block base (X86LogicReference.input state))
  (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice) (left right nextPc : BitVec 64) (aux : BitVec 32)
  (ordinaryDst : dst.reg ≠ 4) (ordinarySrc : src.reg ≠ 4)
  (dstLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16))
  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16))
  (leftRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (rightTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (running : state.modelError = none) :
  have value :=
    X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.w (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)) ^^^
      X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.w (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16));
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16
        KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind.xor (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register dst)
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg X86.Size.w (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                    (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.w value)
                    (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16 == 8)).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.w (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.w value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

  (boundary : CC.isCallCont k = true) :

            fsBase := __src.fsBase, gsBase := __src.gsBase, xmm := __src.xmm, mxcsr := __src.mxcsr,

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicWordReference.step (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins)
  (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (memory : CC.Mem) (block : CC.Block)
  (base : CC.Integers.Ptrofs) (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State)
  (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins memory block base (X86LogicReference.input state))
  (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice) (left right nextPc : BitVec 64) (aux : BitVec 32) (isAnd : Bool)
  (ordinaryDst : dst.reg ≠ 4) (ordinarySrc : src.reg ≠ 4)
  (dstLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16))
  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16))
  (leftRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (rightTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (running : state.modelError = none) :
  have value :=
    X86AluLogicResultEntry.result isAnd (X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.w (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)))
      (X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.w (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16)));
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16
        (X86LogicWordReference.kind isAnd) (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register dst)
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg X86.Size.w (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                    (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.w value)
                    (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16 == 8)).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.w (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.w value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

            CC.Positive.toNat places.pf.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock)
  (separate :
    places.cf.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧
      places.zf.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧
        places.sf.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧ places.overflow.fst ≠ bindingBlock ∧ places.pf.fst ≠ bindingBlock)
  (outside :
    places.cf.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧
      places.zf.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧
        places.sf.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧ places.overflow.fst ≠ cellsBlock ∧ places.pf.fst ≠ cellsBlock)
  (bindingSeparate : bindingBlock ≠ cellsBlock) (permissions : X86LogicFlagWritable.Writable caller places)
  (oldCf : BitVec 8)
  (oldByte :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned caller places.cf.fst places.cf.snd.unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint (BitVec.setWidth 32 oldCf)))
  (cellWritable :
    caller.validAccess CC.Mptr cellsBlock (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst)).unsigned
        CC.Permission.Writable =
      true)
  (tagWritable :
    caller.validAccess CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned cellsBlock
        (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst) + 8).unsigned CC.Permission.Writable =
      true)
  (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins) (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (cpu : X86.Cpu)
  (af : Bool) (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins caller cellsBlock cellsOffset cpu)
  (boundary : CC.isCallCont k = true) :
  have value :=
    X86AluLogicResultEntry.result isAnd (X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.d (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)))
      (X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.d (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16)));
  ∃ final,
    InternalRun ge (37 + X86AluReadOperands.length X86.Size.d + 29 + (X86LogicFlagStage.length X86.Size.d + 197 + 5))
        (CC.State.Callstate (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_sim_inline_arm_ALU_REG)
          [CC.Val.Vptr bindingBlock 0, op, X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte dst),
            X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte src), X86Width.argument flags, CC.Val.Vint aux, imm,
            X86Width.argument width]
          k caller)
        (CC.State.Returnstate CC.Val.Vundef k final) ∧
      X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins final cellsBlock cellsOffset
          (have __src := cpu.setReg X86.Size.d (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst) value;
          { regs := __src.regs, rip := __src.rip,
            flags := X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.d (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.d value) af cpu.flags, mem := __src.mem,
            fsBase := __src.fsBase, gsBase := __src.gsBase, xmm := __src.xmm, mxcsr := __src.mxcsr,
            oracle := __src.oracle, ms := __src.ms }) ∧
        X86LogicFlagMemory.FlagsRepresent final places
            (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.d (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.d value) af cpu.flags) ∧
          final.nextblock = (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).snd.nextblock ∧
            (∀ (row : CC.Block × CC.Z × CC.Z),
                row ∈ CC.blocksOfEnv ge.genv_cenv (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).fst →
                  ∀ (offset : CC.Z),
                    row.snd.fst ≤ offset →
                      offset < row.snd.snd →
                        ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                          final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧
              ∀ (chunk : CC.Chunk) (block : CC.Block) (offset : Int),
                CC.Positive.toNat block < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock →
                  block ≠ cellsBlock →
                    block ≠ places.cf.fst ∧
                        block ≠ places.zf.fst ∧
                          block ≠ places.sf.fst ∧ block ≠ places.overflow.fst ∧ block ≠ places.pf.fst →
                      CC.Mem.load chunk final block offset = CC.Mem.load chunk caller block offset

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicDwordReference.step (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins)
  (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (memory : CC.Mem) (block : CC.Block)
  (base : CC.Integers.Ptrofs) (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State)
  (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins memory block base (X86LogicReference.input state))
  (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice) (left right nextPc : BitVec 64) (aux : BitVec 32) (isAnd : Bool)
  (ordinaryDst : dst.reg ≠ 4) (ordinarySrc : src.reg ≠ 4)
  (dstLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w32))
  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w32))
  (leftRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (rightTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (running : state.modelError = none) :
  have value :=
    X86AluLogicResultEntry.result isAnd (X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.d (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)))
      (X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.d (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16)));
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w32
        (X86LogicDwordReference.kind isAnd) (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register dst)
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg X86.Size.d (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                    (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.d value)
                    (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w32 == 8)).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.d (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.d value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

KProgFormal.ClightRefinement.X86LogicQwordReference.step (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins)
  (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins) (memory : CC.Mem) (block : CC.Block)
  (base : CC.Integers.Ptrofs) (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State)
  (represented : X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins memory block base (X86LogicReference.input state))
  (dst src : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice) (left right nextPc : BitVec 64) (aux : BitVec 32) (isAnd : Bool)
  (ordinaryDst : dst.reg ≠ 4) (ordinarySrc : src.reg ≠ 4)
  (dstLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64))
  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64))
  (leftRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (rightTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned memory block (base + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vint 0#32))
  (running : state.modelError = none) :
  have value :=
    X86AluLogicResultEntry.result isAnd (X86RegisterReadLanes.result left X86.Size.q (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8)))
      (X86RegisterReadLanes.result right X86.Size.q (BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16)));
  KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64
        (X86LogicQwordReference.kind isAnd) (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register dst)
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state =
    {
      state :=
        {
          gpr := fun reg =>
            ((X86LogicReference.input state).setReg X86.Size.q (X86.GPR.ofIndex dst.reg)
                    (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.q value)
                    (dst.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w64 == 8)).regs.get
              (X86.GPR.ofIndex reg),
          rflags :=
            X86LogicReference.flagsWord state.rflags
              (X86.Flags.logic X86.Size.q (X86.Value.trunc X86.Size.q value) (state.oracle.bits state.oracle.cursor)
                (X86LogicReference.input state).flags),
          xmm0 := state.xmm0, memory := state.memory, pc := nextPc, fsBase := state.fsBase, gsBase := state.gsBase,
          addressWidth := state.addressWidth,
          oracle :=
            have __src := state.oracle;
            { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 } },
      events := [] }

    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr caller cellsBlock (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑dst.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong left))
  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr caller cellsBlock (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))

  (addresses : Arm64Registers.PointerOrigins) (origins : KProgFormal.Reference.Provenance.X86.Origins)
  (state : KProgFormal.Reference.X86.State) (nextPc : BitVec 64)
  (represented :

  (nativeBase : CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint64 caller baseBlock baseOffset.unsigned = some (CC.Val.Vlong origins.stack))

  (srcLane : BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) = BitVec.ofNat 8 (src.shift KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w32))
  (running : state.modelError = none) (boundary : CC.isCallCont k = true) :
  have native :=

  (nativeBase : CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint64 caller baseBlock baseOffset.unsigned = some (CC.Val.Vlong origins.stack))
  (dstLane :
    BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 8) =
      BitVec.ofNat 8
        ((KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice.low 4).shift
          (if isWord = true then KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16
          else KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w8)))
  (srcLane :
    BitVec.setWidth 8 (aux >>> 16) =
      BitVec.ofNat 8
        (src.shift
          (if isWord = true then KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16
          else KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w8)))
  (running : state.modelError = none)
  (nonIncreasing :
    CC.Integers.Int64.cmp CC.Comparison.Cgt
        (X86.Value.writeView (if isWord = true then X86.Size.w else X86.Size.b) (left + origins.stack)
            ((fun a b => a ^^^ b)
              ((X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (if isWord = true then X86.Size.w else X86.Size.b)
                (X86.GPR.ofIndex 4))
              ((X86LogicReference.input state).getReg (if isWord = true then X86.Size.w else X86.Size.b)
                (X86.GPR.ofIndex src.reg)
                (src.shift
                    (if isWord = true then KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16
                    else KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w8) ==
                  8))) -
          origins.stack)
        left =
      false)
  (boundary : CC.isCallCont k = true) :
  have native :=
    KProgFormal.Reference.X86.step
      (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.Instruction.logic
        (if isWord = true then KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w16 else KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarWidth.w8)
        KProgFormal.Reference.X86.LogicKind.xor
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarDestination.register (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.RegisterSlice.low 4))
        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state;
  ∃ final,
    InternalRun ge
        (37 + X86AluReadNativeOperands.length 4 src.reg (if isWord = true then X86.Size.w else X86.Size.b) + 29 +
          ((X86LogicFlagStage.length (if isWord = true then X86.Size.w else X86.Size.b) +
              if isWord = true then 216 else 204) +
            5))
        (CC.State.Callstate (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_sim_inline_arm_ALU_REG)
          [CC.Val.Vptr bindingBlock 0, op, X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte 4),
            X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte src.reg), X86Width.argument flags, CC.Val.Vint aux,
            imm, X86Width.argument width]
          k caller)
        (CC.State.Returnstate CC.Val.Vundef k final) ∧
      X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins final cellsBlock cellsOffset
          (X86LogicReference.input native.state) ∧
        X86LogicFlagMemory.FlagsRepresent final places (X86LogicReference.input native.state).flags ∧
          native.events = [] ∧
            native.fault = none ∧
              native.state.pc = nextPc ∧
                (native.state.oracle =
                    have __src := state.oracle;
                    { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 }) ∧
                  native.state.memory = state.memory ∧
                    native.state.xmm0 = state.xmm0 ∧
                      native.state.fsBase = state.fsBase ∧
                        native.state.gsBase = state.gsBase ∧
                          native.state.addressWidth = state.addressWidth ∧
                            native.state.modelError = none ∧
                              final.nextblock = (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).snd.nextblock ∧
                                (∀ (row : CC.Block × CC.Z × CC.Z),
                                    row ∈
                                        CC.blocksOfEnv ge.genv_cenv
                                          (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).fst →
                                      ∀ (offset : CC.Z),
                                        row.snd.fst ≤ offset →
                                          offset < row.snd.snd →
                                            ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                                              final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧
                                  ∀ (chunk : CC.Chunk) (block : CC.Block) (offset : Int),
                                    CC.Positive.toNat block < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock →
                                      block ≠ cellsBlock →
                                        block ≠ places.cf.fst ∧
                                            block ≠ places.zf.fst ∧
                                              block ≠ places.sf.fst ∧
                                                block ≠ places.overflow.fst ∧ block ≠ places.pf.fst →
                                          CC.Mem.load chunk final block offset = CC.Mem.load chunk caller block offset

                      CC.Mem.load chunk final block offset = CC.Mem.load chunk caller block offset

  (aluHelper :

      ge.genv_genv.findFunctPtr bitsBlock = some (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_width_bits))
  (places : X86LogicFlagOrder.Locations) (headers : X86LogicFlagOrder.HeaderLoads caller bindingBlock places)

        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state;
  ∃ final,
    InternalRun ge
        (37 + X86AluReadNativeOperands.length dst.reg src.reg X86.Size.w + 29 +
          (X86LogicFlagStage.length X86.Size.w + 181 + 5))
        (CC.State.Callstate (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_sim_inline_arm_ALU_REG)
          [CC.Val.Vptr bindingBlock 0, op, X86Width.argument (X86RegisterReadValue.registerByte dst.reg),

                    have __src := state.oracle;
                    { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 }) ∧

                    native.state.xmm0 = state.xmm0 ∧
                      native.state.fsBase = state.fsBase ∧

                                      ∀ (offset : CC.Z),

                                            ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                                              final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧

        (KProgFormal.Reference.X86.ScalarSource.register src) nextPc)
      state;

        (CC.State.Callstate (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_sim_inline_arm_ALU_REG)

            imm, X86Width.argument width]
          k caller)
        trace (CC.State.Returnstate CC.Val.Vundef k final) ∧
      X86RegisterView.RegistersRepresent addresses origins final cellsBlock cellsOffset
          (X86LogicReference.input native.state) ∧
        X86LogicFlagMemory.FlagsRepresent final places (X86LogicReference.input native.state).flags ∧
          native.events = [] ∧
            native.fault = none ∧
              native.state.pc = nextPc ∧
                (native.state.oracle =
                    have __src := state.oracle;
                    { bits := __src.bits, cursor := state.oracle.cursor + 1 }) ∧
                  native.state.memory = state.memory ∧
                    native.state.xmm0 = state.xmm0 ∧
                      native.state.fsBase = state.fsBase ∧
                        native.state.gsBase = state.gsBase ∧
                          native.state.addressWidth = state.addressWidth ∧
                            native.state.modelError = none ∧
                              final.nextblock = (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).snd.nextblock ∧
                                (∀ (row : CC.Block × CC.Z × CC.Z),
                                    row ∈
                                        CC.blocksOfEnv ge.genv_cenv
                                          (X86RegisterView.writerAllocation ge.genv_cenv caller).fst →
                                      ∀ (offset : CC.Z),
                                        row.snd.fst ≤ offset →
                                          offset < row.snd.snd →
                                            ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                                              final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧
                                  ∀ (chunk : CC.Chunk) (block : CC.Block) (offset : Int),

                                      block ≠ cellsBlock →
                                        block ≠ places.cf.fst ∧
                                            block ≠ places.zf.fst ∧

                                                block ≠ places.overflow.fst ∧ block ≠ places.pf.fst →
                                          X86ReleaseReturn.ObserverOutside stack ghostPlaces block →

  (rightRead :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Mptr caller cellsBlock (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg)).unsigned =
      some (CC.Val.Vlong right))
  (leftTag :
    CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned caller cellsBlock
        (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑4) + 8).unsigned =
      some (X86Width.argument 0#8))
  (rightTag :
    src.reg ≠ 4 →
      CC.Mem.load CC.Chunk.Mint8unsigned caller cellsBlock
          (cellsOffset + CC.Integers.Ptrofs.repr (16 * ↑↑src.reg) + 8).unsigned =
        some (X86Width.argument 0#8))

  (valueLayout :
    CC.PTree.get X86_program_profile_bpf._x86_sim_inline_value ge.genv_cenv = some X86ShiftLeftCarry.valueRecord)

  (applyBinding :
    ge.genv_genv.findSymbol X86_program_profile_bpf._x86_apply_width = some applyBlock ∧
      ge.genv_genv.findFunctPtr applyBlock = some (CC.FunDef.Internal X86_program_profile_bpf.f_x86_apply_width))

  (differentFlags : X86LogicFlagMemory.Distinct places)

    CC.Positive.toNat places.cf.fst < CC.Positive.toNat caller.nextblock ∧

                                          offset < row.snd.snd →
                                            ∀ (kind : CC.PermKind) (permission : CC.Permission),
                                              final.perm row.fst offset kind permission = false) ∧

                                                block ≠ places.overflow.fst ∧ block ≠ places.pf.fst →
                                          X86ReleaseReturn.ObserverOutside stack ghostPlaces block →
                                            CC.Mem.load chunk final block offset = CC.Mem.load chunk caller block offset
